package.name: cell_backend_sim
package.description: Isaac Sim implementation of the cell_platform_interfaces backends: motion through the Isaac trajectory bridge, gripper through the RG2 controller, poses from the two camera pose topics (fed by simulator truth or, later, sim FoundationPose), scene through the Kit-side command server (Milestone 6). Also the ground_truth_pose_publisher node. Sim only; not built in the Humble container.
